hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] > \$null; \$template = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::GetTemplateContent([Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastTemplateType]::ToastText02); \$text = \$template.GetElementsByTagName('text'); \$text.Item(0).AppendChild(\$template.CreateTextNode('Claude Code')) > \$null; \$text.Item(1).AppendChild(\$template.CreateTextNode('作業が完了しました')) > \$null; \$toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new(\$template); \$appId = (Get-Process -Id \$PID).Path; [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier(\$appId).Show(\$toast)" 2>/dev/null
$json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $json.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -and $f -match '\.py$') { uv run ruff format "$f"; uv run ruff check --fix "$f" }

cmd=$(grep -oP '(?<="command":")[^"]*'); seg=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oP '(?:^|[;&|])\s*(sudo\s+)?rm\s+[^;&|]*' | head -1); blocked=0; if [ -n "$seg" ]; then has_r=0; has_f=0; echo "$seg" | grep -Eqi -- '(^|[^a-zA-Z-])-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*\b|--recursive\b' && has_r=1; echo "$seg" | grep -Eqi -- '(^|[^a-zA-Z-])-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*\b|--force\b' && has_f=1; if [ "$has_r" = "1" ] && [ "$has_f" = "1" ]; then blocked=1; fi; fi; if [ "$blocked" = "1" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"rm -rf (再帰+強制削除) コマンドはhooksにより禁止されています"}}'; else echo '{}'; fi
